title: Gold price hits highest level since June on weak payrolls data and Hormuz deal hopes
summary_full: Spot gold rose as high as $4,295 per ounce before paring gains to $4,268 per ounce on Thursday. Gold futures were seen trading at $4,329 per ounce.
